People around you are stressed: Betty Kowalski. The mood is tense.

Tom sent a brief, professional email to the regional logistics contact Linda Park had introduced — Marcus Webb, fleet operations director at Millfield Distribution Partners — within 48 hours of receiving Linda's introduction. Webb responded the next day: he appreciated Linda's vouching and agreed to a 20-minute call, which Tom scheduled for early next week. It is not a job offer and Tom is not treating it as one, but a scheduled conversation with a real hiring-adjacent contact is exactly what the network activation was supposed to produce. Tom messaged Priya to confirm she is in the loop, then separately called Linda to mention Priya's name as a parallel candidate; Linda said she would reach out to Webb on Priya's behalf as well. Tom completed one full module of his SQL fundamentals course — the joins and aggregation unit — and logged it in his retraining record. The check-in with Carlos Ruiz was brief and human: Carlos acknowledged the disruption without dramatizing it, and Tom left the conversation feeling the relational track of his adaptation plan is holding.
